_doc: Placeholder. Run `scripts/capture_reasoning_usage_fixture.py <model_id> <provider_slug>` with a live OPENROUTER_API_KEY to overwrite this with a REAL usage payload. Both args are required: the D1 billing decision is provider-specific, so the capture pins the provider, opts into router metadata (X-OpenRouter-Metadata: enabled), and verifies the served endpoint matches the pin -- a capture that cannot verify its route fails and leaves this file untouched. The verdict is re-derived by the gate from the rates stored in price_authority (USD per token, with source + fetched_at), never from the mutable curated registry; registry differences are reported as drift instead. While _placeholder is true, the live gate skips; the synthetic-case and routing-metadata tests run regardless.
